description: The Lipscomb Bisons (4-5) visit the Ohio State Buckeyes (4-3) at Schottenstein Center in Columbus. Lipscomb enters following a 101-66 loss to Auburn, while Ohio State saw its two-game win streak end after falling 72-66 to Vanderbilt.

title: Live: College Basketball
